### Security & Quality Checklist
Before requesting review or merging, please verify:
- [ ] Ran local security check: `npm run security:check` or `bash scripts/security_check.sh`
- [ ] Ran PR verification: `npm run pr:check`
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, passwords, or API keys committed
- [ ] No high/critical vulnerability dependencies introduced (`npm audit`)
- [ ] TypeScript check (`npm run lint`) and E2E tests (`npm test`) pass cleanly
